Feedback Literature Review and Research/5 Final/Potential Advisors
Updates:

  • Boredom - Default Mode Network
  • People are uncomfortable with boredom because it leads to introspection
  • reaching out to Cal Newport (these products are solving symptoms, not problem)
  • "making doing nothing worth doing" -potential tagline
  • Potential advisors: David Wang, Micro Journal creator, WPI/CMU/MIT professors, Cal Newport

Feedback:

  • Consider adding some reflections/analysis on past human behavior as it pertains to boredom. How has boredom evolved over time and how have past generations viewed boredom? 
  • Look into the sub-domain of "Design for Behavior Change" - what motivates people to alter their habits and make long term changes? 
    • Can you include some analysis of precedents that solve for behavior change? (i.e. smoking/gambling/addictive behaviors in general). 
  • Can you make the working proposal into a Google doc and add us (Ryan/Akshay as editors)?
